text:
Meena (Sales): Quick POC request from BrightMap — they need short-term extra capacity on dedicated pool dp-63 for a partner demo. Request: +2 GPUs, window 2024-06-12T09:00Z -> 2024-06-13T21:00Z (36h). Also want two scoped API keys for their SREs with IP allowlist and a ballpark cost. Can infra + security help?
Owen (Solutions): Can you confirm model, expected concurrency, and whether they prefer reservation (guaranteed) or burst (best-effort)?
Alex (Client-SRE): Running open-rw-13b-quant, ~180 concurrent, seq ~600. We need guaranteed capacity for the demo, reservation preferred. No external egress.
Rita (EngInfra): We can create a hard reservation for +2 GPUs on dp-63. API example:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools/dp-63/reservations 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_TOKEN" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"reservation_name":"brightmap-demo-20240612","gpus":2,"start_time":"2024-06-12T09:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-06-13T21:00:00Z","hard_cap":true}'```
Rita (EngInfra): For SRE creds we'll create scoped service account keys with TTL 48h and allowed IPs the client provided. CLI:```rdw iam create-key --service-account brightmap-sre --scopes "dedicated:pool:dp-63" --expires-in 48h --allowed-ips "198.51.100.128/27"``` Keys will only permit submit, tail-logs, and metrics.
Claire (Security): Approve on condition of IP allowlist and audit entry. We'll open a temporary access record and require deletion evidence post-demo. No admin scopes allowed.
Billing Bot: Quick estimate: 2 GPUs * 36h = 72 GPU-hrs. Rate $4.60/GPU-hr => $331.20. We can apply a $350 POC credit to cover this. Any extension billed pro-rata.
Owen (Solutions): Recommend adding a fallback route to open-rw-6b-quant for background jobs and enabling prefix KV cache for repeated requests to reduce token spend during the demo. Also set autoscaler cooldown 5m and max_inflight to protect latency.
Rita (EngInfra): Scheduling job now. Scheduler note: reservation must be requested >= 6h before start to guarantee provisioning. If you need a last-minute burst, that's best-effort.
Scheduler Bot: Job queued: jb-20240528-411. Validating capacity for dp-63.
Scheduler Bot: Reservation applied  reservation-id rv-brightmap-20240612-01. Keys created: brightmap-sre-01, brightmap-sre-02 (expire 2024-06-15T09:00:00Z). Audit ticket AT-623 opened. Console events: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/dp-63/events/jb-20240528-411
Alex (Client-SRE): Keys tested, smoke run passed: p50=200ms, p95=540ms. Thanks for the quick turn.
Meena (Sales): I'll send BrightMap the reservation details, credit confirmation, and the security checklist. Please revoke keys after demo and post the audit proof.
Claire (Security): We'll verify revocation and capture logs. If client needs extension, they must open a ticket referencing reservation-id rv-brightmap-20240612-01 at least 4 hours before the end_time with justification.
Rita (EngInfra): Note for ops: if they request more GPUs mid-window, we can convert to a burst or create an incremental reservation depending on availability; will require billing approval.
Meena (Sales): Closing loop — client notified. Thanks everyone :tada:
